QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_75

question.text: Under the key personnel holding restrictions, which of the following is included in the definition of "relative"?

answer.text: Spouse, parents of the person and spouse, siblings of the person and spouse, spouses of those siblings, children of the person and spouse, spouses of those children, and the concerned person's HUF
Only persons living in the same household

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook definition of "relative" covers the spouse; parents of the person and of the spouse; siblings of the person and of the spouse; spouses of those siblings; children of the person and of the spouse; spouses of those children; and the concerned person's HUF. All of these are captured to prevent indirect holdings through family. The Trap: "Spouse and children only" is too narrow, and "first-degree blood relatives" leaves out in-laws and the HUF. "Same household" is a different legal concept and not the test used here. Note: The definition expressly includes spouses of siblings as well as spouses of children — both in-law layers are within scope.
